title: Join us at FABCON + SQLCON 2027 in Atlanta and save
author: RieMerritt

content.text:
Planning to join us at FABCON + SQLCON 2027? Register by November 13 to save $300 with early-access pricing, and use code MSCMTY to save an additional $200.
Plus, a limited number of buy one, get one (BOGO) offers are available. Ask your account team or Fabric partner to find out how to get one.
From March 8–12, 2027, FABCON + SQLCON brings the Microsoft data community together in Atlanta for five days of learning, connection, and hands-on experiences.
Two conferences. One registration.
FABCON + SQLCON brings together Microsoft Fabric, SQL, and Azure AI in one event. You can mix and match sessions and workshops across both conferences based on the topics most relevant to you.
Whether you're exploring Microsoft Fabric, already scaling it in production, building with SQL, or looking at how AI is changing the data landscape, you'll have opportunities to:
• Hear directly from Microsoft and community experts.
• Explore expert-led sessions across Fabric, SQL, AI, analytics, data engineering, governance, Power BI, and more.
• Build practical skills through hands-on workshops.
• Learn from real-world customer experiences and implementation patterns.
• Connect with peers, Microsoft product experts, partners, and the broader data community.
Register by November 13 to save
Take advantage of early-access pricing before it ends:
• Save $300 by registering by November 13.
• Save an additional $200 with discount code MSCMTY.
• Ask your account team or Fabric partner about a limited number of available BOGO offers.
FABCON + SQLCON 2027
March 8–12, 2027
Atlanta, Georgia
Register today and start planning your FABCON + SQLCON 2027 experience.
